findings.message: The CSS fix covers every breakpoint, but the test does not. The round-7 finding pointed out that the ≤480 px rule shrank the button to 48 px. This test checks the 64 px target only at Playwright's default 1280×720 viewport, because playwright.config.ts sets no viewport or projects. So the breakpoint where the defect actually was is never checked. Fix: make the size check table-driven over viewports such as 1440, 768 and 390 px. At each one, call page.setViewportSize, then assert that the button found by the exact name 'Play the 35-second product tour' is at least 64 px tall.
findings.scenario: Someone adds `height:48px` back to the `@media (max-width:480px){… .m2 .play{…}}` rule in welcome.css. The button is 48 px on a 390 px phone, which breaks AC-3, and marketing-video.spec.ts still passes because it only measures at 1280 px.

findings.message: The site now ends every queue outcome line with '· in chat' (queues.ts). The mock's 064 hero card still says '✓ Promoted to Prod by you · deployment recorded', so the mock and the site now give different outcome text for the same card. Fix: add '· in chat' to the mock's queue `.ok` lines too.
findings.scenario: Mock PM card 'Promote' shows '✓ Promoted to Prod by you · deployment recorded'. On /welcome the same card shows '… · deployment recorded · in chat'.

findings.message: The Mock Delta still describes the button as 'A "Play the tour · 35 s, captions" pill', and T3 (line 60) says 'the "Play the tour" button'. AC-3, the code and the mock now use 'Play the 35-second product tour'. Fix: update the Mock Delta and T3 wording to match AC-3.
